request.note: GET probe on project-level cost-rate sub-path. Expected: 405 = path exists, PUT-only; Spring-MVC 404 = path absent.

facts_observed.source_code_evidence: project_admin.go UpdateProjectUserRate line 693: paths.Workspace(wsID, projects, projectID, users, userID, endpoint)

notes: PUT /workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects/{projectId}/cost-rate does NOT exist (Spring-MVC 404). The ours-only endpoint in the spec inventory refers to a project-level rate sub-path that Clockify does not expose. The actual rate update path is per-user: /projects/{projectId}/users/{userId}/cost-rate (405 on GET = path present, PUT-only). clockify_projects_rates_update correctly uses the per-user sub-path.
